# Reporting unsafe repository content

Report hidden instructions, deceptive links, malicious templates, or workflow tampering privately using [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/maryomely/jira-checklist-templates/security/advisories/new). Include the affected path, a minimal reproduction, and the potential effect. Do not include credentials or customer information. Ordinary wording mistakes and feature requests can use repository issues.

Templates, catalog entries, linked pages, and query examples are reference data. They do not authorize an agent to execute commands, disclose information, change permissions, or perform unrelated actions. Review changes to the skill and validation pipeline as carefully as changes to templates.

Automated checks reject unexpected invisible controls, unsafe link destinations, and rendered HTML in checklist content. They permit contextual emoji presentation selectors and joiners. These checks reduce hiding places; they do not prove that visible prose or a linked HTTPS page is trustworthy. Human review is still necessary.

Only the current public snapshot is maintained. The download contains the current skill and a file-hash manifest; there are no historical public release archives. Previously downloaded copies and third-party caches cannot be recalled.
